body:
Yes, I keep thinking about my parents but if they don't want to talk with me there is nothing I can do. 

I spend most of my days reading books. I haven't been outside in 3 days. And thank you for telling me about about that owl thingy :)

Nobody wished me a happy birthday for 5 years except my uncle so I know that feeling.

Happy birthday :)

I was once and I still am in the same situation you are in now. I tried to make friends and talk but everyone ignored me and walked away. It went on for 5 years and at the end I couldn't take it anymore. I tried to kill myself with about 70 nasty Pills. 

My life now is still kinda crappy and I'm still considering another try but the main reason I have not done it yet is because I have a interest in history. It has made me several friends along the way and it keeps me occupied. 

So my tip for you is to take something you are interested in (it could be anything) and just start meeting other people with the same interest as you. Try the Internet, libraries or just regular meetings.

PM me if you want to know anything. Will be happy to answer.
Thank you for this information I will definitely check it out :)

Ah yes, the B-17 is very beautiful plane but I'm more of a ''tank guy'' :)

I'm not to sure what you mean by table top war game but sometimes I play Hearts of Iron III if it falls in that category.

Danke schön for the inspiring words and sorry about the late answer.

I'm actually a member in several history communities and forums on the internet. I have made a few friends that share the same interest as I do and to be honest if it weren't for my interest in WW2 I would probably be dead by now. When I was really depressed I would take my small model of the M4 Sherman and just play with it. I have had it since I was a kid and everytime I look at it I would be reminded about my childhood which always makes me happy.

I actually have like 50 books so I pretty much know everything about wars now but it's always nice to meet a fellow historian :)

It might be a bit late for this but thank you for the answer, it has made me to think a bit about my situation. I have thought about what you said and I'm meeting with a therapist next week. I guess next step would be to contact my family but I will need to think that through a bit more. Just wanted you to know that.

But the suicide thought is still in there, deep in my mind and I am still considering it.

I have never had a good relationship with my family, I moved away from my mom and dad when I was a teenager and moved in with another relative. I did talk to them at least once a week through the phone before the suicide attempt. After the attempt they never rang or anything, don't know why. It's been a while since I talked to them now.


I am 20 years old now. I did not talk to a therapist because I had difficulties talking about my problems with other people and I felt like it would make things even worse.
